children: SanDisk Corporation (SNDK, Financials) is bumping up against a technical ceiling, as its recent rise runs smack into a critical resistance level.

The stock was trading at roughly $1,779 with the last five-hour candle closed at $1,776.11. It nearly touched the $1,832 resistance level at the current high of $1,827.72 which also corresponds to the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement.
The trend overall is still to the upside. SanDisk is above its 200-day simple moving average of $1,626.51 and its SuperTrend line of $1,622.34.

But there are holes in the momentum. The relative strength index was at 65.57 near an overbought level and average directional index at 21.60, indicating a weak trend. Trading volume has also dropped as the stock approaches resistance.

That leaves the $1,832 level as the near-term challenge. A solid five hour close above it, especially on heavier volume would indicate a breakout. Technically, the setup suggests potential targets at $1,980 and $2,100.
A refusal would be another matter. A decline below $1,730 with a loss of momentum would indicate that the breakout attempt has failed and focus may turn to lower support levels.
So the next catalyst is straightforward: Can SanDisk move $1,832 from resistance to support?

title: SanDisk Faces a Make-or-Break Test at $1,832
